title: delphinium speciosum subsp. ranunculifolium
intro:
Delphinium speciosum subsp. ranunculifolium, commonly known as Himalayan delphinium, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its tall spikes of blue or white flowers and fern-like foliage.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan delphinium are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and exhibit antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include delphinine, chelidonine, and protopine alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
